qualification.details: Assistant Project Engineer: Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering or mechanical engineering. Candidates with relevant project experience in the detailed design engineering of chemical process equipment, pilot-plant piping design, preparation and analysis of Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), and operation and performance analysis of chemical engineering pilot plants are encouraged to apply.

salary_details.details: Assistant Project Engineer: Rs. 28500 per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Assistant Project Engineer Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Project Engineer post at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Assistant Project Engineer position at IIT Guwahati is 16th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted online before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Assistant Project Engineer post at IIT Guwahati as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering or mechanical engineering to be eligible for the Assistant Project Engineer role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Project Engineer position will receive a salary of Rs. 28500 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Assistant Project Engineer recruitment at IIT Guwahati is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Assistant Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Project Engineer post at IIT Guwahati involves an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any specific experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with relevant project experience in detailed design engineering of chemical process equipment, pilot-plant piping design, P&IDs, and pilot plant operations are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the 'Important Links' section of this article. The official website is also provided.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IITG/II&SI/Project Staff Rectt-2026/147.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment, meaning the position is temporary and tied to the duration of the specific research project.
